name: Ubukata Satomi
source: Protagonist mother and middle sister. She is a strict mother that is over bearing on protagonist. After catching the protagonist masturbating to her she makes a deal that if he improves his scores she will reward him sexually.
translation: 主人公的母亲，也是三姐妹中的二女。她是个对主人公管教过严的严格母亲。发现主人公对着自己的照片自慰后，她提出交易：只要主人公提高成绩，就奖励他性关系。
